title: Soft Lustre
introShort: Welcome to your salon. Let's make it glow again.
introCard: The bell above the door still rings the same soft note. Rosa hands you the keys with a smile. Open the vanity case, combine your little treasures, and help each guest leave feeling a little more like themselves.

tutorial.welcome: Welcome to your salon. Let's make it glow again.
tutorial.tapVanity: Tap the vanity case to see what is inside.
tutorial.mergeDrops: Drag one lip drop onto the other to merge them.
tutorial.mergeAgain: Lovely. Merge two of those to make something new.
tutorial.clientOrder: Lena is waiting. Find what she asked for.
tutorial.orderComplete: Beautiful work. Lena is so happy.
tutorial.energyLesson: Energy comes back over time. Rest is part of the work.
tutorial.goodbye: Time for tea. Come back soon, the salon will wait.

tips.sell: Not needed right now? Sell an item for a few coins.
tips.locked: Reach the marked level to unwrap more tiles.
